reason: PR-11 extends the PR-06 stub generator into a full defect-to-eval pipeline: registry-backed eval_class mapping, acceptance-test step generation, synthetic replay descriptors, and evidence-packet ref linkage. Proposal-only promotion_status=candidate is preserved.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The overnight driver requires admitted high-severity defects to mint proposal-only EvalCandidates with hash links to evidence packets and registry-defined defect classes, without mutating Semantic Substrate.
diff_review_summary: Replacement keeps ELIGIBLE_SEVERITIES gating and source_defect_record_hash chaining. Adds eval_suite_for_defect_class mapping, acceptance steps from eval_suites.registry, and replay plan hashing. No new regulated vocabulary values are invented.
why_merge_not_sufficient: PR-06 shipped minimal placeholder steps; PR-11 acceptance criteria require suite-specific acceptance tests and replay scaffolding integrated at mint time.
replacement_justification: A single generator module that composes acceptance and replay helpers is the smallest coherent implementation of PR-11 minting behavior.
alternatives_considered: Separate module only, leave PR-06 generator unchanged. Rejected because admission already imports generate_eval_candidate_from_defect.
Substrate schema expansion for replay fields. Rejected to avoid contract surface churn in PR-11.
